scientific_integrity: All universal and asymptotic assertions are proved analytically; finite rational checks and Monte Carlo runs are corroborative and not a replacement for proof.
scientific_limitations: No exact complete finite-dimensional vertex-count distribution or quantitative convergence rate is claimed.
Does not cover nonregular simplices, off-center hyperplanes, or alternate probability measures.
The motivating September 2026 manuscript could be inspected only at public-abstract level; unindexed prior equivalences remain possible.
scientific_scope: Regular simplices in all dimensions at least two, centroidal hyperplanes with Haar-uniform Euclidean normals; exact expected section-vertex count and an asymptotic non-Gaussian deficit law.
title: Exact mean and chi-square fluctuations of Haar central simplex-section vertex counts
